$Comment: The Burning Grave Candle again, priced in Life Essence: a second way to pay for the Headless Horseman's hard ride. Requires holds two conditions at the top level. The hytale:mod_installed gate on MMO Skill Tree (Ziggfreed:MMOSkillTree, Min 1) is there because Life Essence is the MMO's wallet, not this pack's: on a server without the MMO the library leaves this file out at load (one drop line for the ShopEntries store, no warning) and the stall shows only the Sweets offer. The reputation_rank lock is the Sweets offer's own: it opens once Old Jack counts the player Trusted (Honored with Old Jack's Favor), and a locked offer still shows on the shelf with its lock line. Keep the lock the same as Hallows_Eve_Offer_Burning_Grave_Candle.json's and Hallows_Eve_Offer_Burning_Grave_Candle_Trade.json's (the trade shares SortOrder 8 and follows this offer by id). Life Essence is item-backed, so the price is taken as Ingredient_Life_Essence from the bag. SortOrder 8 sits it straight after the Sweets offer (SortOrder 7) on the lanterns shelf. No purchase limit and no rotation. Cost is the price in Life Essence. Named by the item's own keys.
